[b]Happy Birthday to Operation:Tango! [/b]

It's been one year since we launched Operation:Tango and since then we've had players from across the world [i](91 countries in fact!)[/i] work together to save the world!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365266/5fa02091b612eeced8e8ab1cd6f49329bcf565af.png[/img]

We will also be doing giveaways in our community [url=discord.gg/CleverPlays]Discord[/url]! If you're not a part of the Clever Community already, make sure to join us.

Good luck Agents!

~LizMac and the Clever Crew

notes.title: Friend Pass with Full Crossplay!
notes.notes:
You and a friend can team up, no matter which platform, and save the world together as long as one player owns the full game, the other can access it through this app with Friend Pass!

Simply download this app, have the player with the full game create a game code, enter it on your screen, and play!

[b] Please make sure both player's game files are completely up to date otherwise this may cause issues! [/b]

Want more information about Friend Pass? Check out our FAQ on our website [url=http://www.operation-tango.com/operation-tango/faq/]here[/url]

Have a bug or issues? Our team is working hard to make sure everything is working smoothly, but if you find a pesky bug you can let us know on the steam discussion board here, join our [url=https://discord.gg/cvq7Zua]discord[/url] (for the quickest help and most up to date information), or check out the Operation:Tango [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/OperationTango/]Subreddit[/url]. 

Thank you so much for all your support on our first day of launch and we hope you love playing!

notes.title: It Takes Two To Save The World raises funds to support OxFam
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1335790/Operation_Tango/][b]Operation: Tango[/b][/url], you and a friend must work in tandem as Field Agent & Hacker to infiltrate, investigate, and eradicate the forces threatening the free world. [b]Communication and teamwork are key to completing missions, as “It Takes Two to Save the World”.[/b]

But at Clever Plays, that’s so much more than a tagline. To celebrate the release of the playable demo on Steam, [b]we’ve organized the [url=http://www.operation-tango.com/charity]“It Takes Two to Save the World” charity campaign[/url], benefitting Oxfam in their global efforts to fight poverty.[/b]

The concept of the charity is to [b]raise money for each [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1377150/Operation_Tango__Demo/]demo [/url]play-through video we receive[/b], and we already had the pleasure to have many videos from the gaming community! Here are a few we selected : 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VT1YhS_mvy0

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZiRn2sPWl6o

We hope that you enjoyed participating in this great initiative, and if you didn’t have the chance, you still can! So [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1377150/Operation_Tango__Demo/][b]go play the demo on Steam with a friend[/b][/url] and [url=http://www.operation-tango.com/charity][b]come share your experience![/b][/url]

Cheers,

– Val and the Clever Plays team

notes.title: Operation: Tango receives Gamescom Best Multiplayer Game award!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

We have the pleasure and tremendous honor to announce that [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1335790/Operation_Tango/]Operation: Tango[/url] was awarded Best Multiplayer Game at the 2020 Gamescom Awards.[/b]

It is an incredible recognition for us, as winners from previous editions were games like [i]Borderlands 3[/i] and [i]Destiny 2[/i]!

We want to reiterate our gratitude to the Gamescom organization for this wonderful token of appreciation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365266/1829a3cc4ee6df233df2d1dca97e9cdfb4ca57ea.png[/img]

We also got [b]nominated for Most Original Game[/b], alongside [i]Cyberpunk 2077[/i] and [i]Voidtrain[/i], that will be unveiled this Sunday!

[b]If you’re curious about why[/b] they might have chosen our humble indie title, [b]we recommend that you and a friend go [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1377150/Operation_Tango__Demo/]try the demo on Steam[/url] and see for yourself![/b]

notes.title: Operation: Tango at Gamescom 2020
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

[url=https://now.gamescom.global/partner/cleverplays/][b]Gamescom 2020[/b][/url] is now live! [b]From the 27th to the 30th of August[/b], an army of games are showcased in the biggest event of the year!

As part of Ubisoft Entrepreneurs, we have the chance to be a part of the first Online edition of Gamescom. [url=https://online.indiearenabooth.com/?ID=1702]Come visit us at the Indie Arena Booth Online[/url], a unique space dedicated to indie games!

Designed in the spirit of [i][b]Operation: Tango[/b][/i], our virtual booth features [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1377150/Operation_Tango__Demo/][b]a playable demo[/b][/url], [url=https://youtu.be/oJk9RGg7ZZE]the latest trailer[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/cvq7Zua]access to the devs[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1335790][b]a full schedule of activities for all of our fans to enjoy![/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365266/b5fa74b843682fa74fe078bd65f3a4f2303f5c52.png[/img]

Come take part in [b]4 days of giveaways[/b], during which you can [url=https://discord.gg/cvq7Zua]join our Discord server[/url] [b]for a chance to win a free copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/363420/Leap_of_Fate/][i]Leap of Fate[/i][/url] every hour during the event![/b] You will also receive an awesome set of original [b][i]Operation: Tango[/i] emojis for free![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365266/60b9a30c4c757bc703dae7a977dedde0846d3308.png[/img]

We’ve also prepared an [url=https://youtu.be/lRLQcHgTfO4][b]AMA video to answer our fans’ questions[/b][/url] about anything regarding the game, studio, or team, that you can check right [url=https://youtu.be/lRLQcHgTfO4]HERE[/url]!

Additionally, we will be releasing a [b]Let’s Play video with BeeYooTV and Halios [url=https://discord.gg/cvq7Zua]on our Discord tomorrow.[/url][/b] For those of you who don’t have time to try the demo yourselves, [b]you can watch two talented streamers work together to complete the demo mission![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365266/9d35df30978bf08e98cc88e6625d10d288313dbe.png[/img]

And for those of you who want to go hands-on, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1377150/Operation_Tango__Demo/][b]you’ll find the demo available on Steam[/b][/url]. [b]Recruit a friend[/b] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1377150/Operation_Tango__Demo/][b]play it today![/b][/url]

We wish you a great Gamescom! Don’t forget: [url=http://www.operation-tango.com/charity][b]It Takes Two To Save The World![/b][/url]

Cheers,

– Val and the Clever Plays team
